A '''railspeeder''' or '''rail speeder''' was a [[speeder]] vehicle which moved by attaching itself to a single rail that ran across the ground. Several rail speeders were present on the [[moon]] [[Zardossa Stix]], and were able to transport individuals from [[Zardossa Stix Port]] to the [[Temple of Malmourral]]. These rail speeders were used by members of the [[Frangawl Cult]]<ref name="Disappeared pt2">{{TCW|The Disappeared, Part II}}</ref> in [[19 BBY]]<ref name="Disappeared time note">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the events of "[[The Wrong Jedi]]" and the [[Battle of Coruscant]] as being in 19 BBY. {{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-clone-wars-chronological-episodeorder|text=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Chronological Episode Order}} puts the events of "[[The Disappeared, Part II]]" after "The Wrong Jedi," but before the events of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']] which means that its events would take place in the same year as both.</ref> to take their captive [[Queen]] [[Julia]] to the Temple in order to be [[Frangawl sacrificial ceremony|sacrificed]] to [[Malmourral]]. The speeders were used to escape [[Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu]] and [[Junior Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks]], the cultists' pursuers.<ref name="Disappeared pt2" /> Railspeeders were used outside of the [[Citadel Tower]] on [[Scarif]].<ref name="RO junior" />
